title: Count on and back in steps of constant size
description: Count on and back in steps of constant size, including through zero, and recognize negative numbers in context.

title: Recognize simple equivalent fractions
description: Recognize and show, using diagrams and visual models, families of common equivalent fractions.

title: Understand and convert equivalent fractions
description: Understand that equivalent fractions represent the same quantity, and convert between fractions, decimals and percentages.

title: Order and compare fractions and mixed numbers
description: Compare and order fractions whose denominators are all multiples of the same number.

title: Multiply and divide whole numbers by 10, 100 and 1000
description: Multiply and divide whole numbers and those involving decimals by 10, 100 and 1000, explaining place-value changes.

title: Classify 2D polygons based on angles and side properties
description: Distinguish between regular and irregular polygons based on reasoning about equal sides and equal angles.

title: Calculate perimeter and area of compound rectilinear shapes
description: Measure and calculate the perimeter of composite rectilinear shapes in centimeters and meters.

title: Interpret line graphs and frequency tables
description: Solve comparison, sum and difference problems using information presented in a line graph or frequency table.

title: Multiply simple pairs of proper fractions
description: Multiply simple pairs of proper fractions, writing the answer in its simplest form.

title: Use negative numbers in context across zero
description: Use negative numbers in context, and calculate intervals across zero.
